description: Single source of truth for storage retention (AL-01). Declares, per repo-relative directory, the artifact class, TTL, and expiry action enforced by libs/core/storage-janitor.ts. Seeded 1:1 from the pre-catalog in-code constants (behavior-unchanged): tmp 24h, logs 30d, browser-receipts 90d, procedure-deltas 14d, a2a-conversations 30d, data-vault self-expiring. Directories not declared here are never deleted by the janitor; runtime/ subdirectories without an entry are surfaced in the janitor report as uncovered.

entries.note: Formerly DEFAULT_TMP_TTL_MS (24h). Shared scratch floor — anything here is consumable by contract.
Formerly DEFAULT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS. Covers audit/process/surfaces/traces log subtrees.
Browser execution evidence — kept ~90d to align with audit retention (review finding OP-M3).
Self-expiring: each JSON entry carries its own expiresAt, honored per-file by the janitor. No directory-level TTL.
